system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

The clans close association with the Bat sage tribe isn’t just skin deep. Its become a near symbiotic relationship, so much so that the clan has learned ways to utilize sound and turn your enemies vision against themselves. You learn either the Hypnotic Voice or Hypnotic Gaze ability. Beginning at 11th level, you gain the ability, you didn’t select at 3rd level.

| #### Hypnotic Gaze: GM Notes / This feature is left open ended to facilitate Roleplay or even tactical Combat moments. This does leave open opportunities for some disruptive players to attempt to force scenarios or actions on an NPC such as “Kill yourself” or other detestable commands. It is suggested to completely rule against these scenarios and even punish the character within the narrative for attempting it. As always the GM is final rules arbiter for open ended effects and abilities such as these. |

Hypnotic Voice. As an action, you release a screech like sound wave, that overwhelms the senses of all creatures of your choice within a 20-foot cone originating from you, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw. This ability counts as a Genjutsu of a rank equal to the highest rank you can cast, but uses your highest jutsu saving throw DC. Increase the size of this cone +20 feet at 11th level.

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Critical Success: The affected creature is able to resist this abilities effects.

Success: The Affected creature becomes Confused until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures become Confused and Dazed.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the affected creatures are also Slowed.

Hypnotic Gaze. As an action, you stare into the eyes of a single creature you can see within 30 feet of you, release your compelling chakra into them, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw. This ability counts as a Genjutsu of a rank equal to the highest rank you can cast, that you must maintain concentration on, but uses your highest jutsu saving throw DC. A creature that fails or Critically fails cannot suffer its failure or critical failure effects again, until you complete a rest.

Critical Success: The affected creature is able to resist this abilities effects.

Success: The Affected creature becomes Charmed until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures become Charmed and while charmed must spend its Movement and Actions for the next minute obeying one command you give it, that must be done as part of this ability. Once the command is complete, the Charmed condition ends on them.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the affected creature remains charmed, obeying following orders that you give as a Bonus action on your turns for the next minute. Creatures compelled in this way that take damage, can remake their saving throws once per turn.
